# Huineng

*638 – 713 · Chinese · [Chan / Zen](../movements/chan-zen.md)*

Chinese monk, the sixth patriarch of Chan according to tradition: the Platform Sutra attributed to him teaches that Buddha nature is in everyone and that awakening is sudden.
